_comment: id -> icon path override map. Values MUST be real manifest icon paths starting with /common/destiny2_content/icons/. Fill each from the candidate hashes printed by the patched importer's ambiguous log (or a light.gg lookup). Do NOT guess. Entries still set to null are skipped by the importer (the null itself is rejected by the ICON_PATH_PREFIX check), so a half-filled file is safe to commit. Set bonuses are intentionally excluded — they need importer table work, not aliasing.
_ambiguous_artifact_perks_pick_specific_: These 14 print >1 candidate. Duplicated names (Horde Shuttle x3, Shieldcrush x2, Threaded Blast x2, Elemental Siphon x2, Shock and Awe x2) likely share ONE icon per name — but confirm from the logged candidates before assuming.
_unmatched_weapon_perks_zero_candidates: These 15 print 0 candidates — name not found in the manifest inventory-item name lookup. Likely enhanced/normal name collisions or a slightly different manifest name. The re-run's candidate log will show whether they're actually ambiguous; if still truly 0, resolve the exact manifest name via light.gg.
_unmatched_aspect_and_origin_traits: Bastion is a Titan Solar aspect; the two origin traits are common weapon origin perks. All three have exact manifest names.
